title: NBA: Cade Cunningham, Pistons snap Spurs' 12-game winning streak
summary: SAN ANTONI– Cade Cunningham scored 27 points, Daniss Jenkins had 21 of his 25 in the second half and the Detroit Pistons snapped San Antonio’s 12-game winning streak, toppling the Spurs 105-93…

blocks.text: SAN ANTONI– Cade Cunningham scored 27 points, Daniss Jenkins had 21 of his 25 in the second half and the Detroit Pistons snapped San Antonio’s 12-game winning streak, toppling the Spurs 105-93 in the NBA on Tuesday night. Victor Wembanyama had 25 points and 18 rebounds for San Antonio, which had not lost since Oct. 23, when it fell to 0-2. Spurs guard Dylan Harper finished with 20 points but exited with 53 seconds remaining after his left foot slid out from under him and he tumbled to the court. His status is unknown.
